description_en: Queries the URL of an image on the security dashboard
description_zh: 查询安全态势大屏图片资源地址
name: DescribeScreenUploadPicture

parameters.help_en:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL of the logo image on the security dashboard.

>  You can call the [DescribeScreenOssUploadInfo](~~DescribeScreenOssUploadInfo~~) operation to concatenate the values of the host and key fields
parameters.help_zh:
安全大屏logo图片的oss查询地址。
> 通过[DescribeScreenOssUploadInfo](~~DescribeScreenOssUploadInfo~~)接口获取，将host字段值和key字段值拼接
parameters.name: logo_url
